pieces.Text: A fanglord skinwalker can change shape to a bestial form as a standard action. In bestial form, a fanglord skinwalker gains a +2 racial bonus to Charisma. While in this form, a skinwalker also takes on an animalistic feature that provides a special effect. Each time a fanglord skinwalker assumes bestial form, he can choose to gain a bite attack that deals 1d6 points of damage, 2 claw attacks that each deal 1d4 points of damage, +10 foot racial bonus to base speed, or see in darkness (Pathfinder RPG Bestiary 2). These benefits last until the skinwalker returns to his humanoid form as a swift action. A skinwalker must first return to his humanoid form before changing to bestial form again to change benefits.
